title: Reporting offers, suggestions, orders, intentions
summary: Как передавать предложения, советы, приказы, обещания и угрозы: **offer to, suggest -ing / that, advise sb to, order sb to, promise to**.
ru:
## Передаём не слова, а речевое действие
Когда нам важно не воспроизвести фразу, а показать, что человек **предложил, посоветовал, приказал, пообещал**, мы берём глагол, который называет это действие, и добавляем нужную модель. Тогда вместо громоздкого *She said that she would...* получается короткое *She promised to...*
> "Shall I carry your bag?" → He **offered to carry** my bag. — Он предложил понести мою сумку.
> "Let's take the train." → She **suggested taking** the train. — Она предложила поехать на поезде.
> "Don't be late!" → He **told us not to be** late. — Он велел нам не опаздывать.
> "I'll call you." → She **promised to call** me. — Она пообещала мне позвонить.

## Предложения помощи (offer)
- **offer + to-infinitive**: *She offered **to help** with the move.*
- **offer + человек + вещь**: *He offered **me a lift**. She offered **us some tea**.*
- Похожие: **volunteer to do, insist on doing, propose to do**.
> ~~He offered me to help.~~ → He offered **to help (me)**. / He offered **me help**.

## Предложения-советы (suggest, recommend, advise, propose)
- **suggest / recommend / propose + -ing**: *She suggested **meeting** earlier.*
- **suggest / recommend / propose + (that) + clause** с **should** или базовой формой глагола (subjunctive): *She suggested that we **should meet** / **meet** earlier.*
- **advise + человек + to-infinitive**: *The lawyer advised **me to wait**.* · **advise + -ing** без лица: *The lawyer advised **waiting**.*
- ~~She suggested me to leave.~~ → She suggested **that I leave** / **leaving**.
Фразы **Let's... / Why don't we...? / How about...? / Shall we...?** передаются через **suggest**: *"Why don't we leave?" → He suggested leaving.*
Если suggest значит «намекать, указывать на», то после него обычное время: *The data suggested that prices **were** rising.* (подробнее — юнит 40).

## Приказы, просьбы, запреты
**tell, order, command, instruct, ask, warn, remind, urge, beg, advise, invite, forbid, allow + человек + to-infinitive**; отрицание — **not to**:
> The officer **ordered the crowd to leave**. — Офицер приказал толпе разойтись.
> The nurse **asked me to wait**. — Медсестра попросила меня подождать.
> The guide **warned us not to swim** near the rocks. — Гид предупредил нас не плавать у скал.
Формальный приказ: **order / command / demand + that + should / subjunctive**: *The court ordered that he **be** released.*
Различие: **ask to do** (сам хочу) и **ask sb to do** (прошу другого): *He **asked to see** the manager.* — Он попросил о встрече с менеджером (сам хотел его увидеть). *He **asked me to see** the manager.* — Он попросил меня пойти к менеджеру.
Вежливый вопрос передаётся через **ask if / whether**: *"Could I borrow your pen?" → She asked **if she could borrow** my pen.*

## Намерения, обещания, угрозы
**intend / plan / decide / promise / threaten / refuse / agree / volunteer / swear / vow + to-infinitive**:
> "I'll never lie again," he said. → He **swore never to lie** again.
> "If you don't pay, I'll sue you." → She **threatened to sue** him.
> "I won't sign it." → He **refused to sign** it.
Обещание — также **promise + человек + (that) + clause**: *He promised **me that** he would come.* А вот **was going to / planned to** показывают намерение, которое не осуществилось: *He **was going to** call, but he forgot.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She suggested me to leave.~~ → She suggested **that I leave / leaving**.
- ~~He offered me to help.~~ → He offered **to help**.
- ~~She ordered us leave.~~ → She ordered us **to leave**.
- ~~He told us don't be late.~~ → He told us **not to be** late.
- ~~She promised that to call me.~~ → She promised **to call** me.
en:
## We report the speech act, not the words
When we want to show that someone **offered, advised, ordered or promised** something, we choose a verb that names the act and add the right pattern. This gives short sentences instead of *She said that she would...*
> "Shall I carry your bag?" → He **offered to carry** my bag.
> "Let's take the train." → She **suggested taking** the train.
> "Don't be late!" → He **told us not to be** late.
> "I'll call you." → She **promised to call** me.

## Offers
- **offer + to-infinitive**: *She offered **to help** with the move.*
- **offer + person + thing**: *He offered **me a lift**. She offered **us some tea**.*
- Similar: **volunteer to do, insist on doing, propose to do**.
> ~~He offered me to help.~~ → He offered **to help (me)**.

## Suggestions and advice (suggest, recommend, advise, propose)
- **suggest / recommend / propose + -ing**: *She suggested **meeting** earlier.*
- **suggest / recommend / propose + (that) + clause** with **should** or the base form: *She suggested that we **should meet** / **meet** earlier.*
- **advise + person + to-infinitive**: *The lawyer advised **me to wait**.* · **advise + -ing** without a person: *The lawyer advised **waiting**.*
- ~~She suggested me to leave.~~ → She suggested **that I leave** / **leaving**.
**Let's... / Why don't we...? / How about...? / Shall we...?** are reported with **suggest**: *"Why don't we leave?" → He suggested leaving.*
When suggest means "indicate", an ordinary tense follows: *The data suggested that prices **were** rising.* (see unit 40).

## Orders, requests, warnings
**tell, order, command, instruct, ask, warn, remind, urge, beg, advise, invite, forbid, allow + person + to-infinitive**; negative: **not to**:
> The officer **ordered the crowd to leave**.
> The nurse **asked me to wait**.
> The guide **warned us not to swim** near the rocks.
Formal orders: **order / command / demand + that + should / subjunctive**: *The court ordered that he **be** released.*
Compare **ask to do** (the speaker wants it) and **ask sb to do**: *He **asked to see** the manager.* (he wanted to see the manager) *He **asked me to see** the manager.* (he wanted me to go)
Polite questions are reported with **ask if / whether**: *"Could I borrow your pen?" → She asked **if she could borrow** my pen.*

## Intentions, promises, threats
**intend / plan / decide / promise / threaten / refuse / agree / volunteer / swear / vow + to-infinitive**:
> "I'll never lie again," he said. → He **swore never to lie** again.
> "If you don't pay, I'll sue you." → She **threatened to sue** him.
> "I won't sign it." → He **refused to sign** it.
A promise can also be **promise + person + (that) + clause**: *He promised **me that** he would come.* And **was going to / planned to** show an intention that was not carried out: *He **was going to** call, but he forgot.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~She suggested me to leave.~~ → She suggested **that I leave / leaving**.
- ~~He offered me to help.~~ → He offered **to help**.
- ~~She ordered us leave.~~ → She ordered us **to leave**.
- ~~He told us don't be late.~~ → He told us **not to be** late.
structure:
## Модели
| Речевое действие | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| offer | offer + to-inf / offer + obj + noun | He **offered to pay**. · She **offered me** a lift. |
| suggest | suggest + -ing / (that) + clause | She **suggested leaving**. · ...**that we leave**. |
| advise | advise + obj + to-inf / advise + -ing | He **advised me to wait**. |
| order, tell, ask, warn | verb + obj + (not) to-inf | She **told us not to be late**. |
| ask (сам) | ask + to-inf | He **asked to see** the manager. |
| intention | promise / threaten / refuse / intend + to-inf | He **refused to sign**. |
| promise + that | promise + obj + that + clause | She **promised me that** she'd call. |
| formal demand | order / demand + that + subjunctive | The judge **ordered that he be** freed. |

## Прямая речь → косвенная
| Прямая речь | Косвенная речь |
|---|---|
| Shall I...? | offered to... |
| Let's... / Why don't we...? | suggested -ing / that we... |
| Please... / Could you...? | asked (me) to... |
| Don't...! | told / warned (us) **not to**... |
| I'll... (обещание) | promised to... |
| I won't... | refused to... |

exercises.title: Речевое действие: форма
exercises.instruction: Впишите форму глагола или слово, которое нужно (подсказка в скобках).

items.text: 'Shall I carry your suitcase?' he said. → He offered {{to carry}} my suitcase.
'Why don't we try the new Thai place?' said Mia. → Mia suggested {{trying}} the new Thai place.
'Don't open the attachment,' the IT team said. → The IT team told us {{not to open}} the attachment.
'I'll call the police,' she said. → She threatened {{to call}} the police.
'You must wear a helmet,' the instructor told us. → The instructor ordered us {{to wear}} a helmet.
'I won't pay!' said Karl. → Karl refused {{to pay}}.
'Could you wait outside?' the nurse asked me. → The nurse asked me {{to wait}} outside.
'I'll definitely be on time,' said Ali. → Ali promised {{to be}} on time.

exercises.title: Suggest, recommend, order + that
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в нужной форме (в that-clause подойдёт should + глагол или базовая форма глагола — subjunctive).

items.text: She suggested that we {{leave|should leave}} before the rush hour.
Mark recommended that she {{apply|should apply}} for the grant.
The judge ordered that the documents {{be released|should be released}}.
I'd advise {{you to take|taking}} a coat; it's cold outside.
They proposed {{meeting|to meet|that we meet|that we should meet|that they meet|that they should meet}} on Thursday.
He insisted that she {{take|should take}} the day off.
She asked {{to see|if she could see|whether she could see}} the manager. (она сама хотела)
Our guide warned {{us}} not to swim near the rocks.

items.q: 'I'll lend you my notes,' said Ana. → Ana offered ___ me her notes.
'Let's take a break,' said Tom. → Tom suggested ___ a break.
'You'd better see a lawyer,' she told him. → She advised him ___ a lawyer.
'Don't touch anything!' the officer said. → The officer told us ___ anything.
items.why: Приказ с отрицанием: **told us not to touch**.

items.q: 'Do you mind if I sit here?' he asked. → He asked ___ there.
'I'll complain to the manager,' she said. → She threatened ___ to the manager.

items.why: **suggest** не принимает **me to**; нужно **that I apply**.

items.q: The court ordered that he ___ the money.
'I promise I won't tell anyone,' she said. → She promised ___ anyone.
'Can I use your phone?' he asked. → He asked ___ my phone.
items.why: Тот, кто просит, сам хочет пользоваться: **asked to use**.

items.q: 'Could you pass the file?' he asked. → He asked ___ the file.
items.why: Просьба к другому человеку: **asked me to pass**.

items.q: The teacher forbade ___ phones in the exam.

items.why: **suggest + -ing**; после advise me / asked me нужен to-infinitive.

items.q: 'I'll take the blame,' said Ben. → Ben ___ the blame.
(Reported a year later.) 'I'm going to resign,' said Lee. → Lee said he ___ resign.
'Why not ask Sara?' said Dan. → Dan suggested ___ Sara.
'Don't be late!' said the boss. → The boss ___ us not to be late.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя глаголы речевого действия.

items.prompt: What did someone offer to do for you recently? Use: offered to ...
items.sample: My neighbour offered to look after my cat while I was away.

items.prompt: What did a friend suggest doing last weekend? Use: suggested -ing
items.sample: My friend suggested going to the mountains.

items.prompt: What advice were you given? Use: advised me to ...
items.sample: My mentor advised me to learn a second language.

items.prompt: What did someone refuse to do? Use: refused to ...
items.sample: My boss refused to change the deadline.

items.prompt: What have you promised someone? Use: I promised ... to ...
items.sample: I promised my sister to call her every Sunday.
